works.body:
Hello BD56, I'm Naruse Shiina, a personal Vtuber.
I've seen your illustration on Twitter and it's really nice.
I'd love to have you draw it for me, so I've made a request!

Desired use
I would like to use it on social networking sites such as YouTube and Twitter (Youtube is monetized).
I'm going on hiatus at the end of March, so I'd like to use this as a thumbnail illustration for my last video before my hiatus.
I would be happy if you could let me hold a bouquet of flowers.
Please leave the pose and composition to me.

Character data
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ETeayXnTU8tpUD-pykzwKeKSPgiaabqV?usp=sharing
Character : Shiona Naruse
Gender : Female
Height : 150cm

About the data
I would like you to separate the layers so that I can turn on/off the signature and background in the PSD data.

I would be very happy if you could accept my request...! I'm looking forward to working with you.
